items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: Old Red was about to play Kodgen around there.

ctx.x: Yeah, they had a Washboard band.

Oh yeah. Old Red was about to play Kodgen around there. Who's Red? He stood back to the piano. He'd play the piano and drum and that Kodgen. Take a glass and Wawa's like that Kodgen. That's right. Make it sound like that trumpet. What happened to him? I don't know. I haven't seen so many.
The fellas died out so fast, you know.
